method: Windows Chrome, checkout-owned persistent profile, pnpm browser:test. Same fresh quiet-document.md scratch copy; last paragraph scrolled to viewport bottom; secondary click near its right/bottom corner. Before uses both source files from baseCommit; after uses the source hashes above. Native browser chrome is not included in page PNGs.
manualReview: Inspected 1440px Light/English and 640px Dark/Korean before/after captures.
Checked menu row/icon vertical centres, padding, Korean labels, disabled state and shared danger styling.
Confirmed menu stays clear of the scrollbar and docked Outline, with 8px viewport right/bottom clearance.
Compared gutter block, file-row and tab menus at both widths using local captures generated by capture.browser.js.
Manual captures are visual evidence, not screenshot assertions or owner approval.
reproduction: Copy capture.browser.js to apps/editor/test/body-context-capture.browser.js, set LITZIO_BROWSER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5282, and run pnpm browser:test body-context-capture.
Use phase=before with baseCommit source files, phase=after with the PR source. Preserve files between runs.
Remove the temporary scenario after capture; close caller-owned Vite and runner-owned browser sessions.
